name: airwise-ai
description: Urban Air Quality Assistant - GenAI-powered platform helping families navigate winter smog and urban pollution
author: AirWise AI Team

scripts.dev: npm run build:client && npm --prefix server run dev
scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.test: npm run test:server && npm run test:client
scripts.lint: npm --prefix client exec -- tsc -p client/tsconfig.json --noEmit --noUnusedLocals && npm --prefix server exec -- tsc -p server/tsconfig.json --noEmit --noUnusedLocals
